baseline.scope: P21 whole DK input including DK-powered BME; USB disconnected; P22/P23 installed
baseline.window: 30 second power-on window including startup, output switched off afterward
baseline.conversion: ppk2-api 0.9.2 factory coefficients and range-transition filter; 100 ksample/s
baseline.energy_scope: Whole DK power-on window per delivered BME sample, not isolated sensor conversion energy

after.scope: P21 whole DK input including DK-powered BME; USB disconnected; P22/P23 installed
after.window: 30 second power-on window including startup, output switched off afterward
after.conversion: ppk2-api 0.9.2 factory coefficients and range-transition filter; 100 ksample/s
after.energy_scope: Whole DK power-on window per delivered BME sample, not isolated sensor conversion energy

limitations: Whole DK input, including BME, regulators and board loads; USB disconnected.
One startup window per firmware; no repeatability or BME-only attribution established.
Energy per delivered sample includes all window startup/background energy.
Nominal 30 s windows; actual ADC sample durations reported independently.
No Wi-Fi changes; uncontrolled network/runtime variability can dominate a small sensor saving.
